[quote=astanir;59850618][i]Right then, lets get to the details,[/i] says Ikaia. Holisi pushes forward a document with Astanirs first draft of the treaty of Astan, which reads as follows.

[i][b]TREATY OF ASTAN[/b][/i]
[i]This document represents a military and economic alliance between the three states of Astanir, Vorlag and Hasiburg[/i]

[i]Article I: Military Cooperation

1.1 All signatory nations shall engage in regular, bimonthly joint military exercises to enhance interoperability and preparedness.
1.2 In the event of an external attack on one member, all members shall consider it an act of aggression against the entire alliance, prompting a unified military response, as specified below:
1.2.1 Defensive War:
An attack on one member shall trigger a collective defensive response, with all members committed to aid and support the attacked nation militarily.
1.2.2 Offensive War:
In the case of an offensive conflict initiated by a member, members shall only provide supplies and logistical support unless explicitly authorized otherwise by the alliances decision-making body.
1.3 Members shall share military intelligence, strategic information, and technological advancements to strengthen collective security.
1.4 The alliance shall establish a joint military command structure for coordinated operations during times of conflict.

Article II: Economic Cooperation

2.1 All member states shall eliminate trade barriers, tariffs, and restrictions among themselves to promote free and open commerce.
2.2 Trade with non-member nations shall be strictly regulated; such trade shall only occur with prior approval from the Supreme Council of Astan.
2.3 The member states shall collaborate on economic initiatives, infrastructure projects, and technological development to foster regional growth.
2.4 The alliance shall promote economic stability through shared financial resources, mutual investment, and coordinated economic policies.

Article III: Governance and Dispute Resolution

3.1 The treaty shall be overseen by The Supreme Council of Astan, composed of representatives from each member state, responsible for implementing and amending treaty provisions.
3.2 Disputes arising from this treaty shall be resolved through diplomatic dialogue, mediation, or arbitration facilitated by the Council.

Signatures
[/i]

After much debate, the THEP council has come to the decision that action must be taken against the Technokratisches Kaiserreich (TK) in response to their unprovoked aggression against the Sikirskian people and their illegal occupation of the Nestor-Sikirsk territory. Sanctions are to be placed upon the TK by all THEP members and non-members are encouraged to follow. 

These sanctions include banning all trade with the TK, intercepting, searching and potentially seizing any and all ships bound to, or from the TK that enter a nations territorial waters, freezing all TK assets within a country and the banning of all travel to or from the TK (TK citizens within a nations borders at the time of this event will be allowed to safely return).

Additionally, Hydronia has put a TK-only blockade of its section of the eastern strait in place, hoping to damage the TKs trade.
